description:
Remove a recheck created by schedule_recheck before it fires. A pending recheck hasn't been charged anything, so there is nothing to refund. One that has already fired can't be cancelled — its checks bill as they run — and returns error already_ran with its audit_id.

Billing: free.

Returns { recheck_id, cancelled: true } or { error: not_found | already_ran | not_pending, status, detail }.

Example: { recheck_id: "…" }
name: cancel_recheck
title: Cancel a scheduled recheck before it runs
